data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value: Variables and constants Variables (Dim): • Modifiable memory storage during runtime. • Syntax: Dim studentName As String • Multi-Dim: Dim subTotal, total As Decimal Constants (Const): • Immutable fixed values set at compile time. • Syntax: Const TAX_RATE As Decimal = 0.08D Constant Categories: • Named: Defined with Const keyword (TAX_RATE). • Intrinsic: Built into VB (Color.Red, vbCrLf).

data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: Naming rules • First Character: Must begin with an alphabetic letter. • Allowed Characters: Letters, digits, and underscores (_). • Forbidden: No spaces, periods, or punctuation symbols. • Reserved Words: Cannot reuse keywords (Dim, Const, Sub). • Case Insensitive: TotalCount, TOTALCOUNT, and totalcount point to the exact same variable in memory.
